description: One TikTok creator as Viewlify knows it: followers and their 30-day gain, usual views per video, engagement rate, posts per week, best breakout (views vs the usual views at the time), best posting day, most used hashtags and sounds, and their videos with views, likes, comments, shares and a vsUsual multiple. Reads Viewlify's base only; an account it has never seen returns found: false. Without an API key: stats plus 5 videos (the breakout and the most viewed); with a key: up to 50 videos, latest first.

handle.description: TikTok username, with or without @, or a TikTok profile or video link
